about: What changed on nfs4.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. nfs3-webgl's tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: Crackling, robotic sound in the browser: the sound now follows your speakers' pace.
Running out of memory after long sessions: textures the game replaces are now freed.
Running out of memory after many races: finished game threads give their memory back.
A clear message when the browser can't draw the game (WebGL2 off) or is too old, before anything downloads.
The game runs in one tab at a time, and phones no longer ask to capture the mouse.
Gamepads and steering wheels: press a button before Start, then choose it in Options › Controllers.
iPhone and Android: touch controls (buttons, thumb stick or tilt), game files saved on iOS 18 Safari, sound with the silent switch on, and an Add to Home Screen tip for fullscreen.
Game Settings on the start page: start in fullscreen, FPS counter, intro movies, controllers, resolution cap, sharpness and volume.
Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: linked in the menu and in the beta note.
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
A new look: a lo-fi start page with a new emblem and icons.
An early beta notice, with where to report problems.
Smoother menus: the game's threads take turns by priority, as on Windows 98, and file lookups are much faster.
Smoother online races and steadier frame pacing, from NFS3 Web.
First version: Need for Speed: High Stakes (with VEG's Modern Patch) recompiled to WebAssembly. Bring your own game folder; it never leaves your browser.
Online races in the browser over the game's LAN (IPX) mode.
